text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Taaaahhhhhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She denies Orfevre!
Clinching a spectacular victory,
it's Win Variation—!!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I did it, I did it, I did it...!
YESSSS...!!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ――Ha.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Naturally.
Naturally, I will not forgive this...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"This humiliation...!
I shall surely avenge it with radiant brilliance!"

text_block_list.name: Orfe Fan
text_block_list.text: Uwoooh!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
That was a fantastic race!
Could we get a quick word from you?!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ah, thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I never imagined I'd actually win
the Japanese Derby!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"During the race, I was so desperate,
all I could think about was not losing to Ai... to Orfe-san."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Still, my efforts really, truly paid off today...
and that just makes me so, so happy—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Orfe is heading back!
Orfeeee! You're number one!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I want to cheer on your dream.
Next time, show me a glorious comeback!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
...?
Win Variation?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah, ...I'm sorry!
Um, ...I'm just really glad, that's all...
So, that's why—

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Win Variation!
Congrats on winning the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
"Looking forward to the next one too!
Thanks for putting on such a great show!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wa, wah...!?
—Whoa-whoa-whoa!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Anyway,
thank you so much!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Win Variation claims a brilliant victory
in the Nippon Derby!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While Orfevre's defeat was lamented, Tokyo Racecourse was enveloped in an outpouring of cheers and support for Win Variation—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
It feels like a dream.
To think I'm a Derby Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(If I just keep working hard and moving forward
together with Trainer like this—)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(Someday, I might truly surpass Orfevre
and become the leading star.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Nngh!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Alright...! I'm gonna give it my all.
More and more, even more...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Let's do our best together in our next target race, the Kikuka Sho, too!
I'm counting on you...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Next was the Kikuka Sho, the final leg of the Classic Triple Crown.
Days of rushing toward the big autumn stage had begun.
